svg.aria-label: Your agent's work, token-efficient, planned, audited, remembered, production-ready, self-improving. Token-efficient: Skills and project notes load only when a task needs them (caveman, recall). Planned: Brainstorm, write the plan, and test alternatives before building (/dare, /arena, /lab). Audited: A second model reviews the work before you approve it (/codex-review, /impartial-review, /handoff-audit). Remembered: Decisions and pitfalls carry into the next session (pitfalls.md, architecture.md). Production-ready: Health checks, CI, and your approval before anything ships (/wow-loop, /perf-loop, /long-horizon, /long-horizon-workflows). Self-improving: When a workflow stumbles, the fix goes into the skill itself (/refine).
